name: roomate-voice
description: Realtime voice AI companion for Discord

scripts.build:packages: npm run build -w @roomate-voice/config && npm run build -w @roomate-voice/core && npm run build -w @roomate-voice/openai-realtime
scripts.dev: npm run build:packages && concurrently -k -n bot,dashboard -c auto "npm run dev -w @roomate-voice/bot" "npm run dev -w @roomate-voice/dashboard"
scripts.dev:bot: npm run build:packages && npm run dev -w @roomate-voice/bot
scripts.check: npm run typecheck && npm run test && npm run build
